conflict.remediation: Refresh the resource and retry with the current version or idempotency key.
conflict.title: Conflict

denied.remediation: Request the required role from a workspace admin.
denied.title: Permission denied (RBAC)

expired.remediation: Re-authenticate to obtain a fresh token.
expired.title: Token expired

internal.remediation: Retry later or inspect server logs using the request ID.
internal.title: Internal error

notFound.remediation: Check that the referenced Wyrd resource exists.
notFound.title: Resource not found

oneTimeCodeInvalid.remediation: Ask a tenant administrator for a new invitation or reset code; each code is single-use and expires.
oneTimeCodeInvalid.title: One-time code not accepted

passwordAttempts.remediation: Wait `details.retry_after_seconds` until the fixed attempt window ends, then try again.
passwordAttempts.title: Too many password attempts

passwordInvalid.remediation: Check the tenant, username and password and try again; a forgotten password is reset with a code from a tenant administrator.
passwordInvalid.title: Username or password not accepted

recentLogin.remediation: Sign in again with your password or SSO, then create the key within five minutes; an API key or recovery session cannot create one.
recentLogin.title: Recent sign-in required

unauthenticated.remediation: Present a valid Wyrd token as `X-Wyrd-Access-Token: Bearer <token>`.
unauthenticated.title: Not authenticated

upstream.remediation: Check the upstream dependency health and retry policy.
upstream.title: Upstream dependency failed

validation.remediation: Check the submitted Wyrd request fields against the published schema and retry.
validation.title: Validation failed
